tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find products by name or by category and spec filters; returns key specs and the best in-stock offer. Example: {"query":"puck screen","category":"puck_screen","limit":5}

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full specs with per-field confidence and source, every offer with verified time, 30/90-day price range, and the top fits per category with counts. Example: {"product_id":"breville-barista-express"}

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Side-by-side spec table with offers and the fields that differ. Pass 2-10 product_ids, or a category with filters. Example: {"product_ids":["breville-barista-express","breville-barista-pro"]}

tools.name: check_fit
tools.description: Does this part fit that machine? Returns a verdict with the rule id and version that decided it, or the missing fields. Example: {"subject_id":"lucca-puck-screen-58mm","target_id":"breville-barista-express"}

tools.name: check_stock
tools.description: Availability and price per merchant, re-verified live when the data is over an hour old. Example: {"product_id":"lucca-puck-screen-58mm","merchant_id":"www-seattlecoffeegear-com"}

tools.name: report_issue
tools.description: Flag a wrong spec, price or fit verdict. Reports never edit facts; two independent reports mark a fact disputed. Example: {"entity_type":"product","entity_id":"breville-barista-express","field":"portafilter_mm","claim":"Breville lists a 54 mm portafilter for the Barista Express"}
